sources.entry: Create a Blog Web App In Django

summary.title: Django Girls Tutorial
summary.one_liner: You learn to build and put online a small blog web application using Django, aimed at complete beginners.
takeaways: Build a small working blog web application with Django.
Get a gentle introduction to how web technologies fit together.
Publish the finished blog online so others can see it.
Follow along at home or at a Django Girls workshop; video guides are being prepared for some chapters.
The tutorial is available as an ePub e-book and can be translated via Crowdin.
summary.summary: This is the Django Girls Tutorial, a beginner-friendly guide that walks readers through making a personal blog as a working Django web application. The introduction explains that it aims to demystify web technology rather than make readers expert programmers in one step. The page also covers following the tutorial alone with supporting videos, an ePub download, and community translation through Crowdin.
